cc:Work.dc:title: communication-ch2-matched
cc:Work.dc:description: A causal rectangular pulse p(t)=A on [0,T], delayed echo a p(t-d), and matched filter h(t)=p*(T-t). The convolution is a triangular correlation peak at t=T+d, with peak a A^2 T. Diagram T=1 microsecond, d=20 microseconds, peak=21 microseconds. Send and echo windows omit the long waiting interval. Subtract filter delay T to recover radar range c d/2=3 km. No noise realization or measured data are used.
